title: Detailed toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Toothbrush handle: bright blue, angled slightly -->
  <rect x='38' y='50' width='16' height='42' rx='8' fill='#2f8fff'/>
  <rect x='40' y='52' width='5' height='38' rx='2.5' fill='#7fc0ff'/>
  <rect x='41' y='66' width='10' height='3' fill='#d6ecff'/>
  <rect x='41' y='76' width='10' height='3' fill='#d6ecff'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='41' y='38' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#1a6fdd'/>
  <rect x='43' y='38' width='3' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#5aa6f0'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <rect x='36' y='18' width='22' height='24' rx='10' fill='#3f96ff'/>
  <rect x='39' y='20' width='6' height='20' rx='3' fill='#7fc0ff'/>
  <!-- Bristles: two rows of white tufts -->
  <g fill='#f4fbff'>
    <rect x='37' y='10' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='41' y='9' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='45' y='8' width='3' height='11' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='49' y='9' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='53' y='10' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='37' y='20' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='41' y='19' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='45' y='18' width='3' height='11' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='49' y='19' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='53' y='20' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Toothpaste blob for cuteness: mint green with sheen -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='12' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#5fe3a1'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='11.5' rx='2.5' ry='1.2' fill='#c9ffe6'/>
</svg>
